finalText:
**Green. 625 passing, 0 failing.**

Only 3 cases were red, all in `order totals`. `orderTotal` taxed the pre-discount amount. Its own comment says tax goes on the discounted amount.

Fix in [src/pricing.js:39](src/pricing.js:39): `return applyTax(applyDiscount(cents, discountPct), taxRate)`.

Most rows had a zero discount or zero tax, so they hid the bug.
